blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of attractions including go kart racing for different age groups, trampoline park sessions, laser tag, ropes course, bowling, roller skating, VR games, and escape rooms. The park offers daily specials and packages with various combinations of activities. A haunted house experience is available seasonally with multiple themed attractions.
